prompt:
Deliverable: one chibi battle sprite sheet, a single 16:9 landscape image holding exactly eight separate full-body figures of the same character, one image only. It is a game animation sheet; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: Mahmut, an adult man aged 28, drawn in compact chibi proportion: 3.5 heads tall with a large head, broad shoulders, a sturdy weathered build and small hands, and adult facial features (an adult jaw and brow, never a round child-like face). Take his identity from reference image 1: draw the face, the short dark messy hair, the stubble and the brown tired-but-steady eyes of the man shown there, simplified for a small sprite. He wears dark worn half-plate in charcoal steel, repaired with visibly mismatched patched plates (gorget, breastplate, layered pauldrons, vambraces, greaves), plain dark boots and scarred, scuffed gloves. A small Crown Guard star is mounted on the centre of the breastplate and directly above it sits a small empty bare socket where a crown once sat. A tattered oxblood cloak (lit mid-tone #6B1E2C, shadow #371C21, a deep brownish crimson) with bold ragged torn edges hangs behind him and never covers the front of the armour, the sword or the shield. In his right hand he holds an arming sword with a plain straight guard, a plain grip and a pommel set with a flat dull iron disc; on his left forearm he wears a repaired dark heater shield with a bevelled iron rim, riveted repairs and a tiny abstract round seal impression pressed into the rim, with no heraldry on its face. He is bareheaded. The face, armour, cloak and props are identical in all eight figures. His expression is steady and tired with the mouth closed unless a pose says otherwise.
LAYOUT: eight figures on one flat pure #00FF00 background, arranged in four columns and two rows. Imagine the canvas divided into eight equal areas, each one quarter of the image width and one half of the image height, and place exactly one figure at the centre of each area. Reading order left to right, then top to bottom: top row 1 idle, 2 walk, 3 basic attack, 4 active skill; bottom row 5 ultimate, 6 hit reaction, 7 defeat, 8 victory. All eight figures are drawn at one identical scale, as eight different poses of the same character and not a turnaround: the standing idle figure is about 64% of the area height; the walk, basic attack, active skill and victory figures are the same height or within a tenth of it; the hit reaction is about 90% of it; the ultimate is the largest at about 115% of it; the defeat figure is the smallest at about 55% of it. The lowest point of every figure (the planted sole, or the knee in the defeat pose) rests on one shared horizontal baseline about 85% of the way down its area, with nothing hanging below it. Every figure, with its cloak, weapon, chain and bell, lies completely inside its own area and is separated from every neighbouring figure and from the image border by flat empty green at least as wide as twelve percent of one figure's width, so nothing touches or overlaps. Each prop stays physically attached to its figure (the bell hangs from a continuous chain held in the hand, the sword and shield stay in the hands and on the arm). The sheet carries no grid lines, frames, numbers, captions, arrows, shadows or ground.
POSES, every figure facing the right of the frame in a three-quarter view with the chest turned slightly toward the viewer, so the shield on his left forearm is the leading arm on the right side of the figure and the sword in his right hand is on the trailing left side unless the pose swings it forward: 1 idle: relaxed stance with the weight on one leg, the shield held low in front of him, the sword hanging low at his side with its point angled toward the ground. 2 walk: mid-stride with one boot lifted and the other planted, shield and sword held low, the cloak trailing behind him. 3 basic attack, a forward cut: the sword arm swung out to the right with the short blade stretched forward at chest height, the body lunging forward, the shield held up close at his side, eyes hard; the whole blade stays inside the figure's own area. 4 active skill, a guard: feet planted wide, the shield raised in front of the chest and pushed slightly forward to the right, the body braced low behind it, the sword held back and low, jaw set. 5 ultimate: his largest pose, a wide planted stance with the shield thrust high and forward at full arm's length like a wall and the sword raised above his shoulder, the cloak flaring out behind him, mouth closed, eyes hard and level. 6 hit reaction: recoil, the torso jolted back to the left, the shield arm swinging aside, eyes shut tight, teeth clenched, the cloak snapping forward. 7 defeat: kneeling on both knees and slumped forward with his head bowed, the shield slipped down his forearm to rest on the ground, the sword's point touching the ground at a slant in his loosened hand, the cloak pooled around him. 8 victory, restrained: standing upright, the sword lowered at his side with its point toward the ground, the shield arm relaxed, a slow breath out, the faintest softening at the corner of his mouth, chin level.
STYLE: compact chibi game-sprite illustration in a dark gothic anime register, drawn with one uniform bold outline in deep ink (#120A18) about 2 to 3 percent of the figure height, closed shapes, flat two-tone cel shading with one small hard highlight per material, matte woven cloth suggested by a few short hatching strokes, faces simplified but with readable eyes; flat colour areas only, no gradients, no airbrush, no gloss.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: the same soft light from the upper left on every figure with no cast shadows; charcoal steel, ash and oxblood in restrained low saturation, the cloak the only reddish element, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black.
TECHNICAL: the background is flat pure #00FF00, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, floor, vignette, shadow, glow, mist or particles; every figure has a crisp, hard, closed outline so it separates cleanly from the green; no green anywhere on the figures and no green rim light or reflection on cloth or metal; the hair is drawn as a solid dark mass of thick clumped locks without thin flyaway strands; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters or numbers; grid lines or frames; ground shadows; magic or impact effects; blood; a helmet; a crown or royal crest; a bright red cloak; modern items; extra fingers or limbs; a second character.
